blockers.detail: absl/debugging/BUILD.bazel now load(@rules_cc//...); harness WORKSPACE declares no rules_cc (nor bazel_features), so bazel build fails
abseil-cpp now requires C++17; build.sh does not pass -std=c++17, so compilation fails with the old default standard

evidence: compile_matrix h(M^1) x lib(M): fail — external repository '@rules_cc' not declared (bazel analysis); requires C++17 but -std=c++17 not passed
compile_matrix h(fix) x lib(M): ok (fix adds rules_cc + bazel_features in WORKSPACE and --cxxopt=-std=c++17 in build.sh)

rationale.zh: 库的变更引入了两个构建问题：一是在 BUILD.bazel 里新增对 rules_cc 的 load（新构建依赖），旧 harness 的 WORKSPACE 没声明该依赖；二是 abseil 开始要求 C++17，旧 build.sh 没设编译标准。二者任一不修都会构建失败，修复 H 同时补上 rules_cc+bazel_features 与 -std=c++17 后恢复。属于本次引入的显式 configuration 退化（一个 fix 修两个 configuration 子问题）。
rationale.en: The library change introduces two build problems: (1) BUILD.bazel now loads @rules_cc while the old harness WORKSPACE declares no rules_cc; (2) abseil now requires C++17 while build.sh does not set the standard. Either one alone breaks the build; fix H adds rules_cc + bazel_features and -std=c++17 to recover. Explicit configuration degradation introduced by this change (one fix, two configuration sub-issues).

verification.budget_note: 已用 bazel 7.4.0 实测三格中的两格。格2（h(M^1) × lib(M)）：M 版 abseil（2370ccf5）+ 数据集里的旧 WORKSPACE，bazel build --nobuild //:probe 在 29.27s 后失败，报 "cannot load '@@rules_cc//cc:cc_test.bzl': no such file"，rc=1 —— 确认 rules_cc 依赖缺失。格3（h(fix) × lib(M)）：换成 H（538e5a594e）的 WORKSPACE（补了 bazel_features 1.21.0 与 rules_cc 0.2.14），同一 target 在 84.33s 后构建成功，rc=0。格1（h(M^1) × lib(M^1)）未能测出：该组合要解析旧 WORKSPACE 的 rules_fuzzing -> rules_python 0.20.0 链，bazel 在 fetch 阶段因 github.com 连接超时失败（Connect timed out），属环境问题；佐证是修复版的缓存里同样没有 rules_python，说明修复版根本不走这条依赖链。另需说明：C++17 那个子问题（build.sh 缺 -std=c++17）本次未单独实测。
